promotions.title: Activate Money Safe, Get a Pacific Coffee Voucher
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Receive HKD 30 Pacific Coffee e-Cash Voucher when you activate Money Safe
promotions.description: Customers who deposit any amount into a Money Safe account receive a HKD 30 Pacific Coffee e-Cash Voucher. Money Safe is an anti-fraud measure introduced by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority that allows customers to lock funds in their accounts to prevent unauthorized transactions. Locked funds continue to earn the same interest rate as unlocked funds (either Savings or Time Deposit rates). To unlock funds, customers must make an appointment via the EleBank Mobile App and visit the bank office in person to complete the offline unlock procedure, with funds released within three working days after identity verification. This promotion is available on a limited quota, first come, first served basis with no minimum balance requirement for the locked amount.
promotions.quota: Limited quota, first come, first served

promotions.title: Flight Booking Cashback Reward with Visa Card - HKD 800 or HKD 240
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Earn up to HKD 800 cash rebate on air ticket purchases with EleBank Visa Card
promotions.description: EleBank Visa cardholders receive a maximum cash rebate of HKD 800 (limited to once per customer) when using their registered eligible Visa Card to pay for air tickets booked with Air New Zealand, ANA, Ethiopian Airlines, EVA AIR, or Singapore Airlines via their designated official Hong Kong or Macau websites. For single transactions of HKD 8,000 or above, customers receive HKD 800 cash rebate; for transactions between HKD 4,000 and HKD 7,999, customers receive HKD 240 cash rebate. Promotion periods vary by airline, and customers should refer to the specific Terms & Conditions for each airline. The offer is subject to limited quota on a first come, first served basis.
promotions.quota: Limited quota, first come, first served, maximum once per customer

promotions.title: Travel with Visa – Flight Booking Cash Rebate (HKD800 Maximum)
promotions.highlight: ✈️ Earn up to HKD 800 cash rebate on air ticket purchases with your Visa Card
promotions.description: EleBank Visa cardholders can earn cash rebates when booking flights through the official Hong Kong or Macau websites of Air New Zealand, ANA, Ethiopian Airlines, EVA AIR, or Singapore Airlines. Customers who charge a single transaction of HKD 8,000 or above receive HKD 800 cash rebate (maximum once per promotion period), while transactions between HKD 4,000 and HKD 7,999 receive HKD 240 cash rebate. The promotion period varies by airline, and the offer is available on a first-come, first-served basis with limited quota. Eligible cardholders must use their registered Visa Card to pay for the air tickets on the designated airline websites.
promotions.quota: Limited quota, first come first served

promotions.title: EleBank Visa Platinum Card with Transaction Protection
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Real-time fraud protection with 24/7 Shield Monitoring
promotions.description: The EleBank Visa Platinum Card offers comprehensive transaction security protection with its Shield Monitoring feature. This feature provides 24/7 real-time fraud protection to keep cardholders' transactions secure at all times. The card provides premium banking services with no limitations, allowing customers to enjoy stellar services regardless of their assets or status. Cardholders can apply directly through the EleBank app and manage their card alongside other banking services on the same platform.

promotions.title: EleBank 5-Minute Mobile Account Opening
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Open a bank account in as fast as 5 minutes via mobile
promotions.description: EleBank offers a streamlined account opening process that can be completed in as little as 5 minutes through your mobile device. This digital banking service allows customers to quickly access EleBank's financial technology ecosystem without visiting a physical branch. The bank continually innovates the banking concept to create stellar banking services shared by everyone. EleBank is a licensed digital bank approved by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority, ensuring all services meet regulatory standards.

promotions.title: No Account Management Fees and No Minimum Deposit
promotions.highlight: 💸 No account management fees and no minimum deposit requirements
promotions.description: EleBank offers fee-free banking services with no account management fees and no minimum deposit requirements. This policy makes banking accessible to all customers regardless of their financial status or account balance. Customers can enjoy the full range of EleBank's digital banking services without worrying about maintenance fees or having to maintain minimum balances. This approach aligns with EleBank's mission to provide inclusive banking services to everyone, regardless of assets or status.

promotions.title: EleBank Personal Loan with Preferential Interest Rates
promotions.highlight: 💰 Personal loans up to 12x monthly salary with customized rates
promotions.description: EleBank offers personal loans with customized interest rates tailored to individual customers. Loan amounts can reach up to 12 times the customer's monthly salary or HKD1,000,000 (whichever is lower). The entire loan process, from application to fund disbursement, can be completed in as fast as 5 minutes. The actual annual percentage rate ranges from 7.43% to 35.05%, with repayment periods from 6 to 60 months. EleBank provides this 24/7 real-time service to meet customers' urgent financing needs.

promotions.title: Multi-Currency Savings Account with No Minimum Balance
promotions.highlight: 💱 Flexible deposit accounts with no minimum balance in multiple currencies
promotions.description: EleBank provides multi-currency deposit accounts with no minimum balance requirements. Customers can choose from flexible time deposit periods with the ability to open deposits 24/7. The service includes both demand deposits and time deposits in multiple currencies. EleBank also offers interest rate boost coupons that allow customers to earn additional interest on their deposits. Customers can manage their deposits conveniently through the EleBank app, with the flexibility to access their funds when needed.

promotions.title: Flexible Time Deposit with Interest Rate Boost Coupons
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Flexible term time deposits available 24/7
promotions.description: EleBank offers flexible time deposits that can be opened anytime through their 24/7 digital banking platform. Customers can choose from various term options to suit their financial needs. The service includes the option to use interest rate boosters to earn higher returns on deposits. This time deposit service is available to all EleBank customers and can be managed entirely through the EleBank app without needing to visit a branch.

promotions.title: 24/7 Multi-Currency Foreign Exchange
promotions.highlight: 💱 Round-the-clock currency exchange with real-time rates for 11 currencies
promotions.description: EleBank offers 24/7 foreign exchange services with real-time quotes, allowing customers to buy and sell currencies at any time. The service supports exchanges between 11 currencies including Hong Kong Dollar, US Dollar, and Renminbi. Transactions are processed instantly with funds immediately credited to the customer's account upon exchange. This service enables customers to take advantage of favorable exchange rates at any hour of the day without being restricted by traditional banking hours.

promotions.title: Multi-Channel Instant Transfers
promotions.highlight: 📲 Multiple transfer options including FPS and instant transfers
promotions.description: EleBank provides comprehensive transfer services supporting multiple currencies including HKD, USD, and RMB. Customers can transfer funds using various identifiers such as mobile numbers, email addresses, or account numbers. The service includes 24/7 instant transfers for HKD and RMB through the Faster Payment System (FPS). All transfer services are accessible through the EleBank app, providing convenient fund movement at any time.

promotions.title: Money Safe Deposit Protection
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Enhanced fraud protection for deposits while maintaining interest earnings
promotions.description: EleBank's Money Safe feature provides upgraded protection to help customers avoid fraud-related losses. This security measure allows customers to lock their funds while still earning the same interest rates as regular demand deposits or time deposits. The locked funds can only be accessed through an in-person appointment, adding an extra layer of security. This feature is part of the anti-fraud measures introduced by the Hong Kong Monetary Authority to protect customer deposits from unauthorized access or fraudulent transfers.

promotions.title: 24/7 Digital Banking Services
promotions.highlight: 🕗 Round-the-clock access to banking services
promotions.description: EleBank provides 24/7 digital banking services allowing customers to manage their finances anytime, anywhere. Customers can access a complete range of banking services including transfers, deposits, loans, and foreign currency exchange through a single app. The service includes 24-hour customer service hotline support for any assistance needed. This always-on banking platform ensures maximum convenience for all EleBank customers regardless of time constraints.

promotions.title: Time Deposit with Early Withdrawal Without Penalty

promotions.description: Ant Bank's time deposit service supports both Hong Kong dollars and US dollars. This gives customers the flexibility to earn interest on their deposits in different currencies according to their financial needs.

promotions.title: Ant Bank Investment Fund Platform Transaction Fee Waiver

promotions.title: Regular Fund Investment Feature

promotions.title: Start Savings from HKD 1

promotions.title: Fusion Bank Global Remittance Service
promotions.highlight: 🌍 Send money globally to family and friends with real-time exchange rates
promotions.description: Fusion Bank offers seamless global money transfer services allowing customers to send funds to any destination worldwide directly from their mobile app. You can purchase foreign currency at real-time exchange rates and send it to international payment networks for cashless spending anywhere. promotions.title: Fusion Bank Flexible Savings Starting from HKD 1
promotions.highlight: 💰 Start saving with as little as HKD 1
promotions.description: Fusion Bank allows customers to start saving with as little as HKD 1. There are no minimum deposit requirements beyond the initial HKD 1, making it accessible for everyone to begin their savings journey. Customers can deposit and withdraw funds at any time through the Fusion Bank mobile application.

promotions.title: First Digital Bank with Foreign Exchange Service
promotions.highlight: 🌏 Send money globally from your smartphone
promotions.description: Fusion Bank provides a global remittance service allowing customers to send money worldwide directly from their smartphone. Customers can buy foreign currency at real-time exchange rates and transfer funds to international destinations or payment networks for cashless spending. This service enables users to stay connected with family and friends across the globe through seamless financial transfers. The foreign exchange service is available 24 hours a day except during system maintenance or special circumstances.

promotions.title: Fusion Flash Monday High-Interest HKD Time Deposit
promotions.highlight: ⚡ Special high-interest HKD time deposit on Mondays
promotions.description: Fusion Bank offers a special high-interest HKD time deposit promotion called 'Flash Monday'. promotions.title: Fusion Bank Savings Interest Plus
promotions.highlight: 📈 Enhanced interest rates on savings accounts
promotions.description: Fusion Bank offers a Savings Interest Plus promotion that provides enhanced interest rates on savings account balances. The promotion is designed to encourage customers to maintain higher balances in their savings accounts. Terms and conditions apply to this offer, which may include minimum balance requirements or other eligibility criteria.

promotions.title: Fusion Bank Foreign Exchange Time Deposit Interest Rewards
promotions.highlight: 💱 Enhanced interest rates for foreign currency time deposits
promotions.description: Fusion Bank offers special interest rewards for customers who exchange currencies and place them in time deposits. This promotion is available for exchanges between HKD, USD, and CNY currencies. Customers can enjoy higher interest rates when they convert their funds and place them in a time deposit with Fusion Bank. There is no limit on the transaction amount for this promotion. Terms and conditions apply to this offer.

promotions.title: 24/7 Foreign Exchange Service
promotions.highlight: 🕒 Exchange currencies anytime with 24-hour foreign exchange service
promotions.description: Fusion Bank provides round-the-clock foreign exchange services available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, except during system maintenance periods or special circumstances. This service allows customers to exchange currencies at their convenience without being restricted by traditional banking hours. The service is available to all Fusion Bank account holders and supports exchanges between various currencies including HKD, CNY, and USD. Exchange rates are subject to market conditions and may fluctuate throughout the day.

promotions.title: Universal Voyage Travel Insurance Plan

promotions.description: The Universal Voyage Travel Insurance Plan offers protection during your travels. This insurance product is available to livi bank customers looking for travel coverage. Customers can purchase this insurance through the livi app before their trips to ensure they have adequate protection while traveling.

The plan likely covers risks such as fire, theft, water damage, and other common household perils. Customers can purchase this insurance through the livi app to protect their homes and valuables against unexpected damages or losses.

promotions.title: Pet Care Insurance

Customers can purchase this insurance through the livi app to ensure their pets receive necessary medical care without financial strain during unexpected health issues.

promotions.title: livi Flexi Loan - Balance Transfer
promotions.highlight: 💳 Transfer balances from other loans or credit cards

promotions.title: livi Business SME Financing

promotions.title: BOC Mastercard® Debit Card

The Mastercard debit card enables customers to make purchases at millions of locations worldwide where Mastercard is accepted, as well as online shopping and ATM withdrawals. Customers can apply for this card through the livi app to access their funds conveniently for everyday spending.

promotions.title: livi QR Cash Withdrawal

promotions.description: Access cash withdrawals using QR codes for a convenient banking experience. This service is available to all livi bank customers with an active account. promotions.title: livi Business Account
promotions.highlight: 💼 Business banking solutions for companies
promotions.description: livi Business Account provides banking services tailored for business needs. This account is available to eligible businesses that meet livi bank's requirements. The business account likely includes features such as business transactions, payment processing, and other financial management tools designed for commercial use. Business owners can open and manage these accounts through livi's business banking platform to handle their company's financial operations efficiently.

promotions.title: 3-Minute Investment Account Opening for Existing Customers
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Open a bank account in as fast as 3 minutes
promotions.description: PADB offers an expedited account opening process that can be completed in as little as 3 minutes for standard applications where no additional documents or information are required. This digital onboarding service is available to both Hong Kong residents and visitors physically present in Hong Kong. The quick account opening process features no minimum balance requirement.
promotions.quota: Hong Kong residents and visitors physically present in Hong Kong

promotions.title: Discounted Subscription Fee for Bond Funds
promotions.highlight: 🔽 Reduced subscription fees on investment funds
promotions.description: PADB offers discounted subscription fees for various types of funds. Money market funds come with no subscription fees, bond funds are available at a reduced subscription fee of 0.5%, while mixed and equity funds have a competitive subscription fee of 1%. This pricing structure makes investing in funds more accessible and cost-effective compared to traditional channels, which typically charge 2-3% for fund subscriptions.
promotions.cost: Money market funds: Free; Bond funds: 0.5%; Mixed and equity funds: 1%

promotions.title: Global Investment Access Platform
promotions.highlight: 🌎 Access global markets with HK stocks, US stocks, funds and money market funds
promotions.description: PADB provides comprehensive global investment access through its integrated platform, featuring Hong Kong stocks, US stocks, funds, and money market funds. The service allows customers to easily diversify their investments across different asset classes and global markets. Users benefit from a seamless experience switching between banking and investment functions, with all capabilities available in a single account.
promotions.cost: Free platform access; trading fees apply for specific investment products

promotions.title: Banking Services for Hong Kong Visitors
promotions.highlight: 🌏 Banking services available to visitors physically in Hong Kong
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank offers banking services to visitors who are physically present in Hong Kong. This allows non-residents to access banking services during their stay in the city.
promotions.quota: Only for visitors physically present in Hong Kong

promotions.title: Hong Kong Stock Trading Commission Rate
promotions.highlight: 🆓 Trade Hong Kong stocks with no platform fee
promotions.description: PADB offers Hong Kong stock trading with no platform fees, allowing investors to trade more cost-effectively. The service includes real-time market indices to help investors determine optimal trading timing. Customers only pay a competitive commission of 0.15% with a minimum charge of HKD 50 per transaction.
promotions.cost: 0.15% commission with minimum HKD 50 per trade; no platform fee

promotions.title: Banking Security × Brokerage-Grade Trading Power
promotions.highlight: 🔐 Enjoy bank-level security with professional trading capabilities
promotions.description: PADB combines robust banking security with professional brokerage-grade trading capabilities in a dual-strength investment account. Customers can effortlessly switch between investments and deposits, enabling agile portfolio management in changing market conditions. The service provides diversification options and smooth execution without friction, allowing users to stay ahead of market changes.
promotions.cost: Free account access; trading fees apply for specific investment transactions

promotions.title: Free Real-time Level 1 Market Data for Hong Kong Stocks
promotions.highlight: 📊 Access real-time Level 1 Hong Kong stock market data at no cost
promotions.description: Once you activate stock investment services, enjoy free access to Level 1 real-time Hong Kong stock quotes through the Ping An Digital Bank mobile app. This service provides immediate market information without additional fees.
promotions.quota: Available to all customers with activated stock investment services

promotions.title: Real-time US Stock Quotes
promotions.highlight: 🇺🇸 Get real-time US stock market quotes without additional fees
promotions.description: Access real-time US stock market data after activating stock investment services, provided you are not classified as a professional investor by NASDAQ. This service helps you make timely investment decisions in the US market.
promotions.quota: Available to non-professional investors with activated stock investment services

promotions.title: Services for Residents and Visitors in Hong Kong
promotions.highlight: 🌏 Banking services available for both HK residents and visitors
promotions.description: Banking services available to both Hong Kong residents and visiting customers who are physically present in Hong Kong. Offers comprehensive banking capabilities for all eligible customers.

promotions.title: Low Minimum Investment for Money Market Funds
promotions.highlight: 💵 Invest in money market funds from just $20 USD
promotions.description: PADB offers USD money market funds with a low entry threshold of just 20 USD. These funds provide a relatively stable investment option with lower volatility and uncertainty compared to other investment products.

promotions.title: Time Deposit Account
promotions.highlight: 💰 Steady and reliable growth with time deposits
promotions.description: Time deposit accounts that support steady and reliable growth. Flexibly arrange your funds to earn interest with both current and time deposit accounts.

promotions.title: Low Minimum Investment Threshold for Money Market Funds
promotions.highlight: 💰 Start investing with as little as HK$100 or US$20
promotions.description: PAObank allows customers to start investing in money market funds with a low minimum threshold of HK$100 for HKD funds or US$20 for USD funds. This makes wealth management products accessible to a wider range of customers.

promotions.title: Time Deposit Growth
promotions.highlight: 💰 Steady and reliable growth through time deposits
promotions.description: PAObank offers time deposit services to help customers achieve steady and reliable growth on their savings. This service provides a secure way to earn interest on funds deposited for a fixed period.

promotions.title: Multiple Insurance Options
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Diverse insurance options including life, savings, motor, home, and travel
promotions.description: PAObank offers a comprehensive range of insurance products including life, savings, motor, home, and travel insurance. Applications can be completed through the bank's mobile app, with personalized advisory services available for wealth and legacy planning.

promotions.title: Low Minimum Fund Subscription
promotions.highlight: 💵 Invest in funds with as little as USD 20
promotions.description: Ping An Digital Bank allows customers to subscribe to money market funds with a minimum amount as low as USD 20. This low entry barrier makes fund investment accessible to more customers regardless of their investment capital.

promotions.title: WeLab Global Wallet - Best Exchange Rates Guarantee
promotions.highlight: 💱 Get up to HKD 100 refund if you find a better foreign exchange rate within 5 minutes of transaction
promotions.description: Customers who exchange HKD 100,000 or more into eligible foreign currencies in a single transaction can receive a refund of up to HKD 100 if they find a better rate from a third-party Hong Kong bank within 5 minutes after completing their WeLab Bank FX exchange transaction. Customers must submit the refund application within 24 hours of the transaction via email to wecare@welab.bank with proof of the third-party bank's quote and transaction details. Each eligible customer can claim this refund only once per 12 calendar months based on the transaction date. The refund is limited to one qualifying FX transaction per 12-month period with a maximum refund of HKD 100.
promotions.quota: One transaction per 12 calendar months per customer

promotions.title: WeLab Global Wallet Debit Card - $0 Foreign Currency Transaction Fee
promotions.highlight: 💰 Zero foreign currency exchange fees on all WeLab Bank FX transactions
promotions.description: WeLab Bank charges no foreign currency exchange fees for all customers conducting foreign currency transactions regardless of purpose, whether for investment, travel, or education expenses. This is a permanent feature of WeLab Bank's FX service with no hidden charges or additional fees applied to currency conversions. All transaction fees are waived, allowing customers to keep more of their funds when exchanging currencies.

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Unlimited $0 Fund Subscription and Switching Fees
promotions.highlight: 📈 Zero fund subscription fees and zero switching fees with unlimited transactions
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers unlimited $0 fund subscription fees and $0 fund switching fees for all customers investing through the Digital Wealth Advisory and Featured Funds services. This is a permanent feature with no limits on the number of transactions, allowing customers to flexibly allocate their funds and build diversified passive income streams without incurring subscription or switching charges. Customers can make unlimited fund purchases and switches at no cost.

promotions.title: Investment Fund Cash Rewards - Up to HKD 4,000
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Earn up to HKD 1,500 cash reward when you subscribe to funds with a minimum investment of HKD 100,000
promotions.description: Earn up to HKD 1,500 cash reward by participating in the April Investment GO program. Customers must have successfully opened a valid Core Account with WeLab Bank on or before 31 March 2026, maintain their Core and Investment Accounts between 9 April 2026 and 21 April 2026, and subscribe to any fund via Featured Fund Services or GoWealth Digital Wealth Advisory with an aggregate investment amount of at least HKD 100,000 (or equivalent) at or before the cut-off time. The reward is capped at HKD 1,500 per eligible customer. This promotion is open to existing WeLab Bank customers who meet all eligibility criteria during the specified period.
promotions.quota: Eligible customers who meet all conditions

promotions.title: WeLab Global Wallet New Customer Dual Welcome Offer
promotions.highlight: 💰 New customers earn up to HKD 5,000 in cash rewards including 4% deposit interest and HKD 4,000 fund investment cash reward
promotions.description: New customers can enjoy approximately HKD 5,000 in total rewards by opening an account using the promo code 'WL5000'. The rewards consist of up to 4% annual interest rate on GoSave 2.0 one-month time deposits and HKD 4,000 cash reward for qualified fund transactions. Customers must successfully open an account during the promotion period from 1 May 2026 to 31 May 2026 (inclusive). The exact reward amount depends on the deposit and investment amounts placed, with the deposit interest calculated based on principal and duration. This offer is exclusive to new customers opening accounts during the specified promotion period.
promotions.cost: Free to apply, minimum deposit/investment amounts apply for specific rewards

promotions.title: Selected Customers Foreign Currency Exchange Promotion with HKD 50 Cash Reward
promotions.highlight: 🌍 Earn HKD 50 cash reward when you exchange HKD 20,000 or more in a single foreign currency transaction
promotions.description: Selected existing customers can earn HKD 50 cash reward when they successfully exchange HKD 20,000 or more into eligible foreign currencies in a single transaction through WeLab Bank App during the promotion period from 1 March 2026 to 31 May 2026. Eligible customers are those who did not conduct any foreign currency exchange transactions via WeLab Bank App's FX Trading feature between 1 June 2025 and 28 February 2026. This promotion is limited in quota on a first-come, first-served basis and is subject to terms and conditions.
promotions.quota: Limited quota, first-come-first-served for selected customers

promotions.title: WeLab Global Wallet Multi-Currency Support with Automatic FX Top-Up
promotions.highlight: 🌍 Support for 11 currencies with automatic instant currency conversion when balance is insufficient
promotions.description: WeLab Global Wallet debit card supports 11 major currencies including Japanese Yen, US Dollar, Chinese Yuan, Australian Dollar, British Pound, Euro, Singapore Dollar, Canadian Dollar, Swiss Franc, New Zealand Dollar, and Hong Kong Dollar. The card features automatic foreign currency top-up functionality that instantly converts Hong Kong Dollars to the needed foreign currency at the current exchange rate when your foreign currency balance is insufficient for a transaction or ATM withdrawal, enabling seamless cross-currency spending without pre-loading all currencies. This is a permanent feature available to all WeLab Global Wallet cardholders.
promotions.quota: All WeLab Global Wallet debit cardholders

promotions.title: WeLab Global Wallet Overseas ATM Withdrawals
promotions.highlight: 💳 Withdraw cash at any overseas ATM displaying Mastercard or Cirrus logos
promotions.description: WeLab Global Wallet debit card holders can withdraw cash at any overseas ATM displaying Mastercard or Cirrus network logos as well as local JETCO network ATMs. Customers must first activate the overseas withdrawal service through WeLab Bank App before traveling. When withdrawing, customers should select foreign currency settlement instead of Hong Kong Dollar settlement to avoid unfavorable dynamic currency conversion (DCC) rates charged by ATM operators. This is a permanent feature available to all WeLab Global Wallet cardholders.
promotions.quota: All WeLab Global Wallet debit cardholders

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Personal Loan 'R-Friend Referral' Campaign
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn HKD 800 cash reward per successful referral, up to HKD 8,000 (10 referrals)
promotions.description: WeLab Bank customers can earn HKD 800 cash reward each time they successfully refer a friend or relative to apply for WeLab Bank Personal Loan using their designated referral code and the referee completes loan drawdown within 7 days of approval. The maximum referral reward is HKD 8,000 during the campaign period (up to 10 successful referrals). Both existing and new WeLab Bank customers can be referees. The referral reward will be credited into the referrer's HKD Core Account on or before 31 July 2026. If the referrer closes their account within one year of receiving the referral reward, WeLab Bank reserves the right to deduct the credited amount or collect it through other means.
promotions.quota: All WeLab Bank customers are eligible; maximum HKD 8,000 per customer during campaign period

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Personal Loan Cash Rebate Up to HKD 23,888
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 23,888 cash rebate on WeLab Bank Personal Loans
promotions.description: Successful WeLab Bank Personal Loan applicants with an approved loan amount of minimum HKD 150,001 and a tenor of 24 months or more can enjoy up to HKD 23,888 cash rebate if the loan is drawn down within 7 days after approval. The cash rebate amount will be credited directly into the borrower's HKD Core Account on or before 31 October 2026. This rebate applies to both WeLab Bank Personal Instalment Loans and WeLab Bank Debt Consolidation Loans. Eligibility is limited to customers who meet the minimum loan amount and tenor requirements during the campaign period.
promotions.quota: New WeLab Bank Personal Loan applicants with minimum loan amount of HKD 150,001 and 24-month tenor
promotions.cost: Minimum approved loan of HKD 150,001 required; 24-month tenor minimum

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Tesla Unsecured Loan Referral Reward HKD 800
promotions.highlight: 🚗 Earn HKD 800 cash reward when you refer a friend to apply for Tesla Unsecured Loan
promotions.description: WeLab Bank customers can earn HKD 800 cash reward by successfully referring friends to apply for and drawdown Tesla Unsecured Loan using their referral code. The reward structure mirrors the Personal Loan referral program, allowing customers to earn rewards for each successful referral during the campaign period. The referral reward will be credited to your HKD Core Account on or before 31 July 2026. Both existing and new WeLab Bank customers can be referees, and the loan must be drawn down within 7 days after approval to qualify.
promotions.quota: All WeLab Bank customers; existing or new referee customers

promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 1,500 cash reward when you subscribe to funds with minimum HKD 20,000 investment
promotions.description: Participants can earn up to HKD 1,500 cash reward (up to 4.87% one-month annual rate) by subscribing to funds during the promotion period. To participate, you must have successfully opened a valid Core Account with WeLab Bank on or before 31 March 2026, maintain your Core Account and Investment Account between 9 April 2026 and 21 April 2026, and successfully subscribe to any fund via Featured Fund Services or GoWealth Digital Wealth Advisory with investment amount not less than HKD 20,000 equivalent, with aggregate investment not less than HKD 100,000 by the cut-off time on 21 April 2026. The cash reward will be credited to your HKD Core Account according to the tiered reward structure based on your total investment amount. This promotion is open to eligible WeLab Bank customers who meet the account opening and investment requirements during the specified period.
promotions.quota: Eligible WeLab Bank customers who opened accounts on or before 31 March 2026
promotions.cost: Minimum HKD 20,000 per subscription; aggregate minimum HKD 100,000

promotions.title: Tesla Customer Exclusive Personal Instalment Loan Offer
promotions.highlight: 💼 Flexible personal loans for various financial needs
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's Personal Instalment Loan provides customers with flexible financing options for various personal needs. The loan can be used for a wide range of purposes, from home improvements to education expenses or travel. The product features competitive interest rates and flexible repayment terms to suit different customer needs. Applicants can apply through the WeLab Bank app with a streamlined digital application process. During promotional periods, customers may be eligible for cash rebates when meeting specific criteria such as minimum loan amounts and tenor requirements. This loan product is a core offering in WeLab Bank's suite of financing solutions designed to meet customers' diverse financial needs.

promotions.title: GoSave 2.0 4% p.a. Time Deposit for New Customers
promotions.highlight: 💰 Competitive interest rates for time deposits
promotions.description: GoSave 2.0 is WeLab Bank's time deposit product offering competitive interest rates for customers. The service allows customers to lock in funds for a fixed period to earn higher interest compared to regular savings accounts. According to an example in the website, new customers could open two 1-month HKD GoSave 2.0 time deposits with 4% annual interest rate, one with HKD 80,000 and another with HKD 200,000. The combined interest for these deposits would amount to approximately HKD 920.55 (calculated as (HKD 80,000 × 4% ÷ 365 × 30) + (HKD 200,000 × 4% ÷ 365 × 30)). GoSave 2.0 is part of WeLab Bank's suite of savings products designed to help customers maximize their earnings.

promotions.title: WeLab Money Plus Investment Service
promotions.highlight: 💰 Money market fund with returns up to 4.4% in the past year
promotions.description: WeLab Money Plus (also referred to as WeLab 閒智寶) is a money market fund offered through WeLab Bank's Featured Fund Services. It provides returns similar to time deposits but without locking in the term. According to the platform, it has achieved returns of up to 4.4% in the past year. The fund is designed for those seeking liquidity while still earning competitive returns. Instructions submitted before the trading day cut-off time (9:00 AM Hong Kong time) qualify for same-day settlement. The Value US Dollar Money Market Fund B Class (HKD) (Accumulation) specifically showed a one-year return of up to 4.43% and a total return of 10.48% since its establishment on November 22, 2023.
promotions.cost: Minimum investment of HKD 100 or USD 15

promotions.title: Apple Products Subscribe+ Program
promotions.highlight: 🍎 Installment plan specifically for Apple product purchases
promotions.description: The Subscribe+ for Apple Products program (also called Apple 產品好賞分期計劃 in Chinese) is a specialized installment plan offered by WeLab Bank for customers who wish to purchase Apple products. This financing option allows customers to spread the cost of Apple devices over multiple payments, making premium technology more accessible. The program is specifically designed for Apple products and offers competitive payment terms. Customers can apply for this financing through the WeLab Bank app. This installment plan is part of WeLab Bank's partnership with Apple and reflects their strategic collaborations with leading technology companies.

promotions.title: Policy Loan Service
promotions.highlight: 📝 Loans using insurance policies as collateral
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers Policy Loans that allow customers to use their existing insurance policies as collateral to obtain financing. This loan option enables policyholders to access liquidity from their insurance assets without surrendering their policies or losing coverage. The Policy Loan product is designed for customers who have built up cash value in their insurance policies and need access to funds for various purposes. The loan amount is typically based on the cash surrender value of the policy. This financing option is part of WeLab Bank's comprehensive loan offerings, which include personal instalment loans, card debt consolidation loans, and specialized financing solutions.

promotions.title: Money Safe Feature
promotions.highlight: 🔒 Enhanced security features for your funds
promotions.description: Money Safe (智安存 in Chinese) is a security feature offered by WeLab Bank designed to provide enhanced protection for customers' funds. This feature helps safeguard customer deposits against unauthorized access and transactions. Money Safe is part of WeLab Bank's commitment to providing secure banking services in the digital environment. The service likely includes various security protocols and measures to ensure that customers' funds remain protected. This security feature complements WeLab Bank's digital-first approach to banking, providing customers with peace of mind while conducting their financial activities through the WeLab Bank app.

promotions.title: Learn Now Pay Later Program
promotions.highlight: 📚 Flexible financing option for educational expenses
promotions.description: The Learn Now Pay Later Program is a financing solution offered by WeLab Bank that allows customers to pay for educational expenses over time. This program enables customers to access educational opportunities immediately while spreading the cost over a more manageable payment schedule. The financing option is designed to make education more accessible by reducing the upfront financial burden. Customers can apply for this loan program through the WeLab Bank app. The Learn Now Pay Later Program is part of WeLab Bank's diverse loan offerings, which include personal instalment loans, card debt consolidation loans, and other specialized financing options.

promotions.title: Card Debt Consolidation Loan
promotions.highlight: 💳 Consolidate high-interest credit card debt into a single loan
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers a Card Debt Consolidation Loan that helps customers combine multiple high-interest credit card debts into a single, potentially lower-interest loan. This product is designed to simplify debt management by consolidating various credit card balances into one monthly payment, potentially at a lower interest rate. The consolidation can help customers save on interest payments and better manage their finances with a clearer repayment schedule. Customers can apply for this loan through the WeLab Bank app, with the potential to qualify for cash rebates when meeting certain criteria during promotional periods. This loan product is part of WeLab Bank's loan offerings aimed at helping customers better manage their financial obligations.

promotions.title: Featured Funds Services with Over 170 Funds
promotions.highlight: 🌐 Access to over 170 mutual funds from top global fund houses
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's Featured Funds Service provides access to more than 170 mutual funds from top global fund houses. The service features a user-friendly interface that showcases popular investment ideas, allowing customers to invest in mutual funds, dividend funds, bond funds, and more with just one click. Investment can start from as low as HKD 100 or USD 15, making fund investment more accessible. The service displays various fund categories like high-yield funds with annual returns up to 7.6%, global income funds with returns up to 6.4%, and conservative dividend funds with returns up to 4.0%, among others. This ongoing service allows customers to easily track market trends and make informed investment decisions.
promotions.cost: 0.1% monthly platform fee on total fund holdings

promotions.title: GoWealth Digital Wealth Advisory
promotions.highlight: 🤖 AI-powered investment advisory service with personalized portfolio recommendations
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's Digital Wealth Advisory Service, branded as 'GoWealth', provides personalized investment portfolio recommendations based on individual investment goals and personal situations. The service allows customers to set investment objectives, including investment period and one-time or monthly investment amounts. The system then generates tailored portfolio recommendations. After accepting the advice, the system executes the initial investment and sets up automatic monthly investments according to the customer's specifications. The service includes various notifications about investment progress, though these are not investment advice. Customers can monitor progress and adjust goals as needed through the WeLab Bank app.
promotions.cost: 0.1% monthly platform fee on total fund holdings

promotions.title: Quick Account Opening Service
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Open a bank account in as fast as 2 minutes
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers a quick account opening service that allows new customers to open a bank account in as little as 2 minutes. This digital onboarding process enables customers to quickly access WeLab's banking services, including investments, without the need to visit a physical branch. After completing the account opening process, customers can immediately begin using their Core Account and activate additional services like the Investment Account. The service is designed to make banking more accessible and convenient through digital channels. Actual account opening time may vary depending on different factors.

promotions.title: Smart Finance with AI Technology
promotions.highlight: 🤖 Highly personalized banking experience powered by Generative AI and AI Agents
promotions.description: WeLab Bank offers a smart banking experience powered by AI technology to help customers grow their wealth. The bank has established an AI-first strategic partnership with Google to apply artificial intelligence across operations, product design, and marketing. This technology allows WeLab Bank to provide highly personalized financial services for savings, loans, and investments. Customers can manage global debit cards, international transfers, and access loans all through one app, freeing up their time for other priorities.

promotions.title: AI-First Digital Banking Services
promotions.highlight: 🤖 Highly personalized customer experiences using Generative AI and AI Agents
promotions.description: WeLab Bank provides AI-powered banking services through its strategic partnership with Google, applying artificial intelligence across operations, product design, and marketing. This service offers a personalized banking experience tailored to individual customer needs and preferences. Customers can access intelligent financial tools for savings, loans, and investments designed to help them save and earn more efficiently. This always-on AI-first approach represents WeLab's core commitment to delivering smarter banking.

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Digital Wealth Advisory Service
promotions.highlight: 🤖 AI-powered personalized investment portfolio management
promotions.description: WeLab Bank's GoWealth Digital Wealth Advisory is a permanent service that offers personalized investment portfolio recommendations using AI technology in partnership with Allianz Global Investors. Customers can set investment goals including investment period and contribution amounts, and the system provides tailored portfolio recommendations. After accepting the recommendation, the system will make the initial investment and continue with automated monthly investments based on the customer's settings. The service provides ongoing notifications about investment progress and allows customers to monitor and adjust their goals as needed. This is not a discretionary asset management service, and the recommendations do not guarantee investment outcomes.
promotions.cost: 0.1% monthly platform fee on fund holdings

promotions.description: New customers get 50 extra chances to participate in the lucky draw promotion when using Global Wallet Debit Card for overseas spending. This is in addition to the automatic entry and 3% cashback on overseas transactions.

promotions.title: 50 Extra Lucky Draw Chances for New Customers
promotions.highlight: 🎲 New customers get 50 extra lucky draw entries
promotions.description: New customers can receive 50 additional lucky draw chances for the Easter Lucky Draw promotion. Combined with overseas spending rebates, new customers can maximize their rewards when using the Global Wallet Debit Card.

promotions.title: WeLab Bank New Customer 2-in-1 Welcome Offer
promotions.highlight: 💰 Enjoy up to HKD 5,000 cash rewards with time deposit and investment
promotions.description: New customers who open an account with promo code 'WL5000' can enjoy dual welcome benefits: up to 4% p.a. time deposit interest rate and up to HKD 4,000 investment fund cash reward, totaling approximately HKD 5,000 in rewards.

promotions.title: WeLab Bank Referral Rewards for Personal Loan
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn HKD 800 for each successful Tesla loan referral
promotions.description: Customers can refer friends who are Tesla owners to apply for WeLab Bank personal instalment loan with promo code 'TESLA5' to enjoy the special 4.55% APR offer. For each successful referral, the referrer will receive HKD 800 cash reward.
promotions.quota: Up to 10 successful referrals per customer (maximum HKD 8,000 reward)

promotions.title: ZA Bank Fund Trading – 0% Subscription Fees on ALL Funds (No Cap)
promotions.highlight: 💰 Enjoy 0% subscription fees on ALL funds with no cap
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers 0% subscription fees on all funds with no cap, meaning 100% of your money goes into the market. This is a permanent feature available to all ZA Bank investment customers. There are no eligibility restrictions or time limits on this offer. Customers can access this benefit by trading funds through the ZA Bank investment platform.

promotions.title: ZA Card - StockBack Direct Stock Rewards (Get shares instead of points)
promotions.highlight: 📈 Earn stocks directly from your daily spending with StockBack x ZA Card
promotions.description: Hong Kong's first StockBack x ZA Card allows cardholders to earn stocks directly through everyday spending instead of just accumulating points. Spending with the card automatically accumulates stocks that can be used to build a personalized reward package. This is a permanent card feature available to all ZA Card holders with no end date or special eligibility requirements. The program rewards users for their regular card usage by converting spending into actual shareholdings.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Multi-Currency Savings Account (0% Forex Conversion Spread)
promotions.highlight: 💱 Hold 11 different currencies with flexible 24x7 exchange and zero fees
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers multi-currency savings accounts where customers can hold 11 different currencies including HKD, CNY, USD, GBP, SGD, EUR, CAD, AUD, JPY, NZD, and CHF. Customers can exchange currencies 24 hours a day, 7 days a week at their preferred rates with zero fees. This is a permanent core banking feature with no end date or special eligibility conditions. Flexible asset allocation allows users to seize market opportunities and grow wealth across multiple currency positions.

promotions.title: ZA Bank High-Interest Savings Pot (Deposit and withdraw anytime, zero fees)
promotions.highlight: 🏦 Dedicated high-interest savings pot with deposit/withdraw anytime at zero fees
promotions.description: ZA Bank provides a dedicated high-interest savings pot that allows customers to deposit and withdraw funds anytime with zero fees. This is a permanent savings feature available to all ZA Bank account holders with no expiry date or special conditions. Interest earnings are designed to help grow customer wealth while maintaining complete flexibility and liquidity. The product combines competitive interest rates with the convenience of on-demand access to funds.

promotions.title: ZA Card - Custom Card Number (Choose your own last 6 digits)
promotions.highlight: 🎴 Choose the last 6 digits on your card face
promotions.description: ZA Bank is the first in Hong Kong to allow customers to choose the last 6 digits displayed on their ZA Card face. This is a permanent personalization feature available to all ZA Card holders with no end date or special conditions. The customization option enhances card personalization while maintaining security and functionality. Customers can select their preferred numbers during card issuance or request changes through the ZA Bank app.

promotions.title: ZA Card – No Annual Fees, No Hidden Fees, Digital & Physical Options
promotions.highlight: 💳 Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees
promotions.description: ZA Card is a Visa debit card with no annual fees or hidden charges, providing transparent and cost-free card ownership. This is a permanent core feature of the ZA Card product available to all card holders. The card supports digital payment methods including Apple Pay and Google Pay for convenient contactless transactions. Customers can use their ZA Card for spending, earning rewards, and building investment portfolios without worrying about card maintenance fees.

promotions.title: ZA Card - PowerDraw Lottery (Win up to 200% rebate + HKD 1 million prize pool)
promotions.highlight: 🎰 Win up to 200% rebate via PowerDraw with a chance to share HKD 1 million
promotions.description: ZA Card users can participate in PowerDraw by spending with their card to win rebates up to 200% along with a chance to share HKD 1 million through MillionTix rewards. This is an ongoing permanent program with no expiry date or special eligibility conditions beyond holding a ZA Card. Participants accumulate entries through regular card spending, with the potential for significant cash rebates and shared prize pools. The program is available to all active ZA Card holders.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Stock Trading – 0% Brokerage, 0% Custody Fees, From HKD 18 Platform Fee
promotions.highlight: 📊 Trade stocks with 0 brokerage, 0 custody fees, and platform fee as low as USD 1.99/HKD 18 per transaction
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers stock trading with 0% brokerage fees and 0 custody fees, with platform fees as low as USD 1.99 or HKD 18 per transaction. This is a permanent feature of the ZA Bank investment platform available to all eligible customers. The service supports trading in both US stocks and HK stocks with minimal costs. Customers can access this benefit by opening an investment account and beginning stock trades through the ZA Bank platform.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Account Opening in 2 Minutes (Zero deposit requirement)
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Open an account in as fast as 2 minutes online
promotions.description: ZA Bank allows HK residents and visitors in Hong Kong to open an account online in as fast as 2 minutes with zero deposit requirement. This is a permanent account opening feature with no special eligibility conditions beyond residency or visitor status. The streamlined digital process eliminates the need for in-person visits or lengthy documentation. All account opening can be completed anytime, anywhere through the ZA Bank mobile app.
promotions.quota: HK residents and visitors in Hong Kong

promotions.title: ZA Bank ATM Cash Withdrawals – Free at 3,000+ Visa ATMs Across Hong Kong
promotions.highlight: 🏧 Free cash withdrawals at over 3,000 Visa ATMs across Hong Kong
promotions.description: ZA Card holders can withdraw cash for free at over 3,000 Visa ATMs throughout Hong Kong. This is a permanent feature of the ZA Card with no expiry date or special conditions. All ZA Card customers are eligible to use this service at any time. There is no cap on the number of free withdrawals or amount withdrawn.

promotions.title: ZA Bank 24/7 Customer Service – Round-the-Clock Support
promotions.highlight: ☎️ 24x7 customer service available anytime
promotions.description: ZA Bank provides 24 hours, 7 days a week customer service support to all account holders. This is a permanent service feature with no end date or special eligibility conditions. Customers can reach support representatives at any time to address inquiries, resolve issues, or receive assistance with their accounts. The round-the-clock availability reflects ZA Bank's commitment to convenient and accessible banking.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Global Transfers to 140+ Countries (International remittance service)
promotions.highlight: 🌍 Send global transfers to over 140+ countries and regions
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers global transfer services to over 140 countries and regions, enabling customers to send money internationally with ease. This is a permanent core banking service available to all eligible ZA Bank account holders. The service supports multiple currency transfers and is designed for customers with international financial needs. Access to global transfer capabilities is available 24/7 through the ZA Bank mobile app.
promotions.quota: All eligible ZA Bank account holders

promotions.title: ZA Bank Free Instant FPS Transfers (No fees for domestic transfers)
promotions.highlight: ⚡ Free instant FPS transfers, card payments, tax payments, and scan-to-pay all in one app
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers enjoy free instant FPS transfers with the ability to send and receive money using just a mobile phone number. The Frequent Payee section enables quick and easy transfers to regular recipients.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Instalment Loan with APR as Low as 1.30%
promotions.highlight: 💳 APR as low as 1.30% with loan amount up to HKD 1,000,000
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers instalment loans with competitive APR rates starting as low as 1.30% and loan amounts up to HKD 1,000,000. This is a permanent lending product available to eligible ZA Bank customers. Repayment periods extend up to 72 months, providing flexible borrowing options for various financial needs. Customers can apply for instalment loans through the ZA Bank app to settle expenses or consolidate existing debts.

promotions.title: ZA Bill Master Card Bill Settlement
promotions.highlight: 💰 Settle multiple card bills at once with up to 72 months repayment period
promotions.description: ZA Bank's Bill Master product allows customers to consolidate and settle multiple card bills in one transaction with extended repayment periods of up to 72 months. This is a permanent debt consolidation feature available to eligible ZA Bank customers. The service simplifies bill management by combining multiple payments into a single loan facility. Customers can access Bill Master through the ZA Bank app to streamline their monthly bill payments.

promotions.title: ZA Bank ZME $18M Hassle-Free Financing
promotions.highlight: 🚗 $18M hassle-free financing available with flexible terms
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers ZME $18M hassle-free financing for customers with various borrowing needs. This is a permanent financing product available to eligible ZA Bank customers. The service provides accessible credit with simplified application and approval processes. Financing can be accessed for multiple purposes and arranged through the ZA Bank mobile app.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Crypto Trading – $0 Platform Fee for First 90 Days After Account Opening
promotions.highlight: 🪙 New customers enjoy $0 platform fee for the first 90 days after account opening for crypto trading
promotions.description: New ZA Bank customers can trade crypto 24/7 directly with their HKD or USD deposits and enjoy $0 platform fees for the first 90 days after account opening. Trading is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week with no minimum investment stated.
promotions.cost: Free for first 90 days after account opening

promotions.highlight: ⚡ Free instant FPS transfers, card payments, tax payments, and scan-to-pay all in one app
promotions.description: ZA Bank provides permanently free instant FPS (Faster Payment System) transfers for all customers with no end date or expiry condition. The service includes free instant transfers between ZA Bank customers, card payments, tax payments, and scan-to-pay functionality all integrated into a single mobile app. Customers can receive HKD and CNY using just their mobile phone number via FPS. Additional convenience features include a Frequent Payee section for quick repeated transfers and group Lai See distribution with one tap requiring no individual recipient entry.
promotions.quota: All ZA Bank customers; no limit

promotions.title: ZA Bank Referral Program - MGM Activity with Account Opening Rewards

promotions.description: ZA Bank offers rewards for customers who successfully refer friends to apply for and take out loans. Referrers can earn up to HKD 900 in rewards when their referred friends complete loan applications and meet the program's conditions. This referral program incentivizes both existing and new customers to promote ZA Bank's lending products to their network.

promotions.title: ZA Bank 6th Anniversary Campaign – Up to HKD 60,000 StockBack Grand Draw
promotions.highlight: 🎯 Earn up to HKD 60,000 in StockBack stock rewards plus up to 12% stock rebate on coffee shop spending
promotions.description: ZA Bank's 6th Anniversary Campaign ran from 1 April to 21 April 2026 and offered multiple ways to earn StockBack stock rewards. All users could win up to HKD 60,000 by simply logging into the app, with users whose age ends in '6' (e.g., 26, 36) receiving double chances to win. Cardholders using StockBack x ZA Card at local coffee merchants earned 6% stock rebate on qualifying transactions over HKD 10, or 12% at specified partner coffee merchants, capped at HKD 50 total in combined rebates per participant. Users could also earn StockBack through ZA Quest tasks, the StockBack x ZA Card reward plan, and the 'Stock Lucky Draw'. Top 60 users accumulating the most StockBack in each of 3 campaign phases (1–7 Apr, 8–14 Apr, 15–21 Apr) won a metal StockBack x ZA Card valued at HKD 1,000; ranks 61–1,000 received early access to the physical card. All stock rewards must be converted to actual shares within 48 hours or they expire and are not re-issued.
promotions.quota: All users eligible; top 1,000 per phase for leaderboard rewards
promotions.cost: Free to participate in lottery; minimum HKD 10 spend for coffee rebate

promotions.title: ZA Bank 6th Anniversary StockBack Leaderboard Rewards - Metal Card and Priority Card Access
promotions.highlight: 🏆 Top 60 weekly leaderboard users win a StockBack x ZA Card metal card (value HKD 1,000); ranks 61–1,000 receive early physical card access
promotions.description: As part of ZA Bank's 6th anniversary promotion running from 1 Apr 2026 to 21 Apr 2026, a leaderboard ranking system awards prizes to top-performing StockBack users across three phases: Phase 1 (1–7 Apr), Phase 2 (8–14 Apr), and Phase 3 (15–21 Apr). StockBack score accumulates through completing designated ZA Quest tasks and selecting stocks, making purchases with ZA Card via the StockBack rebate program and selecting stocks, or obtaining specified stock exchange vouchers through the stock lottery. The top 1,000 users by cumulative StockBack score each phase are ranked: positions 1–60 receive a StockBack x ZA Card metal card worth HKD 1,000; positions 61–1,000 receive priority access to experience the physical StockBack x ZA Card. Each customer can receive a maximum of one (1) leaderboard reward across the entire promotion period. Participants must hold a valid ZA Card and investment account. Rewards are credited according to promotion terms.
promotions.quota: Top 1,000 per phase; maximum one reward per customer across full promotion

promotions.title: Zero-Fee Visa Debit Card
promotions.highlight: 💳 Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees
promotions.description: ZA Card is a Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees. The card supports Apple Pay and Google Pay, providing a truly free banking card option for all users.

promotions.title: ZA Bank HKD 20% p.a. 7-Day Time Deposit for New Referred Customers
promotions.highlight: 📈 Enjoy 20% p.a. interest on 7-day HKD time deposits
promotions.description: New ZA Bank customers referred by existing users can receive two 19.9% p.a. 7-day HKD time deposit interest boost coupons (plus base rate for total 20% p.a.). The first coupon is awarded when depositing ≥ HKD 1,000 within 14 days of account opening, valid for deposits up to HKD 20,000. A second coupon is granted when maintaining HKD 1,000 balance across deposits, funds and stocks, valid for deposits up to HKD 100,000.
promotions.quota: New customers who open accounts with referral codes during the promotion period
promotions.cost: Must deposit ≥ HKD 1,000 for first coupon; must maintain combined balance of HKD 1,000 across deposits, funds and stocks for second coupon

promotions.title: ZA Card StockBack 6th Anniversary 6% Cashback on Coffee
promotions.highlight: ☕ Get 6% stock rebates at all coffee merchants
promotions.description: During ZA Bank's 6th anniversary celebration, customers could earn 6% StockBack rewards when spending at any local coffee merchant using their ZA Card. Qualifying transactions needed to be at least HKD 10 and made directly with the card (not through Alipay or WeChat Pay). The reward cap for special coffee merchant rebates was HKD 50 per user during the promotion period.
promotions.quota: All ZA Card holders; maximum combined special rebates capped at HKD 50 per user
promotions.cost: Minimum spending of HKD 10 per transaction required

promotions.title: ZA Bank 24x7 Customer Service
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Round-the-clock customer support every day
promotions.description: ZA Bank provides 24/7 customer service for all users, ensuring assistance is available at any time of day. This always-on support system allows customers to resolve issues, ask questions, and receive guidance regardless of time constraints. The service is part of ZA Bank's commitment to convenient digital banking that overcomes traditional banking limitations.
promotions.quota: Available to all ZA Bank customers

promotions.title: ZA Bank Refer to Take Out a Loan Program
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 900 for referring friends to ZA Bank loans
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers can earn rewards up to HKD 900 by referring friends to apply for loans with ZA Bank. The referral program provides cash incentives when referred friends successfully obtain loan products. Reward amounts vary based on the loan type and amount approved for the referred friend.
promotions.quota: Available to all existing ZA Bank customers
promotions.cost: Free to participate; referred friends must complete loan application and approval process

promotions.title: Wise Express Remittance Service
promotions.highlight: 🌐 Fast international transfers powered by Wise
promotions.description: ZA Bank has partnered with Wise to offer express remittance services for HKD payments, providing faster international transfers than traditional methods. This service enables customers to send money internationally with competitive exchange rates and transparent fee structures. It complements ZA Bank's suite of global transfer options, including SWIFT transfers to over 140 countries.
promotions.cost: Fees vary by destination and amount

promotions.title: ZA Bank Insurance Application in as Fast as 3 Minutes
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Get insured via smartphone in as little as 3 minutes
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a fully digital insurance application process that can be completed in as little as 3 minutes via smartphone. Options include life insurance, critical illness insurance, and Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme (VHIS) with a simplified claims process.

promotions.title: 24x7 Currency Exchange
promotions.highlight: ⏰ Exchange currencies anytime with 24/7 availability
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers can exchange between 11 currencies 24 hours a day, 7 days a week at their preferred rates. This allows users to seize market opportunities at any time and grow their wealth through flexible currency exchange.

promotions.title: Currency Exchange Discount Voucher HKD 126
promotions.highlight: 💱 Get HKD 126 discount on currency exchange
promotions.description: New customers receive a HKD 126 currency exchange discount voucher as part of the new customer reward package. The voucher is valid for 30 days after receipt and can be used for eligible currency exchange transactions.
promotions.quota: New customers only; Valid for 30 days after receipt

promotions.title: HKD 100 Overseas Remittance Cash Rebate
promotions.highlight: 🌎 Receive HKD 100 rebate on overseas remittance
promotions.description: New customers receive a HKD 100 overseas remittance cash rebate voucher as part of the welcome package. The voucher can be applied to eligible overseas remittance transactions within 30 days of receipt.
promotions.quota: New customers only; Valid for 30 days after receipt

promotions.title: ZA Card with No Annual or Hidden Fees
promotions.highlight: 💳 Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees
promotions.description: ZA Card is a Visa debit card with no annual or hidden fees. The card supports Apple Pay and Google Pay for convenient mobile payments.

promotions.title: Open an Account in as Fast as 2 Minutes
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Quick and easy account opening in as fast as 2 minutes
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a streamlined account opening process that can be completed in as fast as 2 minutes when no extra information is required. This service is available to both Hong Kong residents and visitors in Hong Kong.

promotions.title: ZA Credit Loan Referral Program
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 900 for referring friends for loans
promotions.description: Invite friends to apply for loans at ZA Bank and receive cash rewards up to HKD 900 when they successfully take out a loan. The more friends you refer, the more rewards you can earn.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Insurance in 3 Minutes
promotions.highlight: 🛡️ Get insured in as fast as 3 minutes via smartphone
promotions.description: Complete the insurance application process in as fast as 3 minutes via your smartphone. Choose from various insurance products including life insurance, critical illness insurance, and Voluntary Health Insurance Scheme (VHIS) options.
promotions.cost: Insurance premiums vary by product and coverage

promotions.title: ZA Bank Zero Brokerage and Custody Fees
promotions.highlight: 📈 Trade stocks with 0 brokerage and 0 custody fees
promotions.description: Trade stocks with zero brokerage fees and zero custody fees. Platform fees as low as USD 1.99/HKD 18 per transaction. Trade directly with your HKD or USD deposits in your ZA Bank account.
promotions.quota: All ZA Bank investment account holders
promotions.cost: Platform fee starting from USD 1.99/HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.title: 0 Brokerage and 0 Custody Fee Stock Trading
promotions.highlight: 🏦 0 commission and 0 custody fees on all HK stock trades
promotions.description: Trade Hong Kong stocks with 0 commission, 0 custody fees, and platform fees as low as HKD 18 per transaction. This permanent feature allows unlimited trading without paying traditional brokerage commissions, significantly reducing trading costs.
promotions.quota: All users with active stock trading accounts
promotions.cost: Platform fee from HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.title: ZA Bank 0% Platform Fee for New Crypto Customers
promotions.highlight: 🪙 $0 platform fee for crypto trading for first 90 days
promotions.description: New customers can enjoy $0 platform fee for cryptocurrency trading for the first 90 days after account opening. Trade 24/7 directly with HKD or USD deposits.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Hong Kong Stocks Trading Promotion
promotions.highlight: 🏆 Up to HKD 1,500 cash rewards for new stock trading customers
promotions.description: New customers who activate Hong Kong stocks trading can receive up to HKD 500 cash rewards through ZA Quest, plus up to HKD 1,000 cash rebate when buying stocks. Enjoy 0 commission, 0 custody fees, and platform fees as low as HKD 18.

promotions.title: Hong Kong's No.1 Digital Bank
promotions.highlight: 🏆 First digital bank in Hong Kong with highest user base and deposits
promotions.description: As the first digital bank to launch in Hong Kong, ZA Bank had the highest number of users and customer deposits among the city's eight digital banks as of 30 June 2024. ZA Bank offers 24x7 banking services with convenient digital features.

promotions.title: Refer a Friend for Loan Rewards
promotions.highlight: 💵 Earn up to HKD 900 by referring friends for loans
promotions.description: Existing customers can earn up to HKD 900 in rewards for successfully referring friends who take out loans with ZA Bank. This incentive program rewards customers for bringing in new loan customers.
promotions.quota: All existing ZA Bank account holders

promotions.title: HKD 1,000 Monthly Fee Savings on Stock Trading
promotions.highlight: 💰 Save up to HKD 1,000 in monthly trading fees compared to traditional brokers
promotions.description: ZA Bank's stock trading service can save customers up to HKD 1,000 in monthly fees compared to traditional brokers. This calculation is based on making one trade per trading day (approximately 20 trades per month) with zero commission, zero custody fees, and platform fees as low as HKD 18.
promotions.cost: Platform fees apply (from HKD 18 per transaction)

promotions.title: 24x7 Customer Service
promotions.highlight: 🧑‍💼 Round-the-clock customer support
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers 24x7 customer service support to all users. Banking services are always available regardless of time of day, with full customer service access.

promotions.title: Customer Referral Program - Referrer Rewards
promotions.highlight: 🤝 Earn up to HKD 90,000 by referring friends to open accounts
promotions.description: ZA Bank's customer referral program rewards users for referring friends to open accounts. Referrers can earn various rewards based on the number of successful referrals, with top referrers eligible for up to HKD 10,000 per phase across 9 phases of the campaign.
promotions.quota: Available to all existing ZA Bank customers

promotions.title: ZA Bank 0% Brokerage & 0% Custody Fees for Stock Trading
promotions.highlight: 📈 0 brokerage and 0 custody fees for Hong Kong stocks
promotions.description: Trade Hong Kong stocks with zero commission and zero custody fees. Platform fee is as low as HKD 18 per transaction, allowing users to save up to HKD 1,000 in monthly trading costs compared to traditional brokers.
promotions.quota: All ZA Bank users with activated stock trading services
promotions.cost: Platform fee as low as HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.title: New User HKD 500 Cash Reward
promotions.highlight: 💵 Get up to HKD 500 cash reward when opening a new account
promotions.description: Selected customers can receive up to HKD 500 in cash rewards when opening a new ZA Bank account. Customers can complete specific tasks in ZA Quest after successful account opening to receive the reward.
promotions.quota: Selected new customers only; not applicable to customers who opened accounts through referral programs or have received other new customer gifts

promotions.title: New Account HKD 2,026 Welcome Reward
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Get rewards worth HKD 2,026 plus 2.5% stock rebate
promotions.description: New users who open an account using a referral code can receive rewards worth HKD 2,026 including fund position rebate vouchers and stock cash rebate vouchers. Additionally, they can enjoy 2.5% stock rebate on eligible purchases.

promotions.title: Fund Redemption Fee Waiver
promotions.highlight: 🆓 Redemption fee waivers for all funds
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers who have activated fund trading services can enjoy redemption fee waivers for all funds until July 31, 2026. This allows investors to redeem their fund investments without paying any redemption fees.
promotions.quota: All retail banking users who have activated fund trading services

promotions.title: ZA Bank Payment Connect Cross-Border Transfer
promotions.highlight: 🌏 Fee-free real-time transfers between Mainland China and Hong Kong
promotions.description: Send money between Mainland China and Hong Kong in real-time with zero fees using Payment Connect. Instant cross-border transfers without any handling charges.

promotions.title: New Stock Trading Customer Cash Rewards
promotions.highlight: 💵 Up to HKD 1,500 in cash rewards for new stock traders
promotions.description: New users can receive up to HKD 500 in cash rewards for opening an account, plus up to HKD 1,000 in cash rebates for buying stocks. This offer is specifically for Hong Kong stock trading customers.
promotions.cost: Must buy stocks to qualify for portion of rewards

promotions.title: Second 20% p.a. Time Deposit for Multi-Product Usage
promotions.highlight: 🔄 Additional 20% p.a. time deposit for using multiple products
promotions.description: New referred customers who hold deposits, funds, and stocks with a total balance of at least HKD 1,000 within 14 days of opening an account can receive an additional +19.9% p.a. 7-day HKD time deposit interest rate booster coupon, providing a second opportunity to enjoy 20% p.a. interest.
promotions.quota: New referred customers using multiple products

products.description: The EleBank Visa Platinum Card is a customizable digital card with Pay Shield fraud protection offering 7/24 real-time fraud monitoring. The card supports both physical and digital payments via Apple Pay and Google Pay, and provides access to nearly 3 million ATMs worldwide with Visa Concierge Service. Foreign currency transactions are subject to additional fees and use the bank's T/T exchange rate plus Visa's exchange rate. ATM fees may apply depending on the ATM network.
products.highlight: 💳 Customizable Visa card with 24/7 fraud protection and global ATM access
features: Apple Pay and Google Pay support
Transaction limit adjustment via mobile app
